recognize_zh: 一團彼此融合的大型細胞，核大且深染、細胞質強嗜鹼性，其中一顆細胞含巨大透明空泡把核擠到邊緣（類印戒樣），細胞遠大於右上角的淋巴球，提示骨髓轉移性腺癌。
features: Cohesive syncytial aggregate of very large atypical cells dwarfing adjacent lymphocytes
Large hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei with nuclear overlap and crowding
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Large clear intracytoplasmic vacuole compressing a nucleus to the periphery (signet-ring-like)
Image is out of focus, limiting assessment of chromatin and nucleoli
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large atypical non-hematopoietic cells with crowded hyperchromatic nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders. One cell contains a large clear cytoplasmic vacuole displacing the nucleus, suggesting mucin or secretory vacuolation. The image is out of focus, limiting evaluation of nuclear detail. In a patient with known pulmonary adenocarcinoma, the findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are single cells with one lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than a cohesive group of separate nuclei with vacuoles.
Histiocytes have small bland nuclei and pale cytoplasm and do not form crowded cohesive aggregates of hyperchromatic cells.
Hematopoietic cells are discohesive with well-defined cell borders and are CD45-positive, cytokeratin-negative.
